title: Chinese Suet Croissant Pastry
description: A sweet and flaky pastry filled with a hint of suet, perfect for a Chinese-inspired dessert or snack.
instructions: Roll out the croissant dough and spread the melted buttery evenly.
Sprinkle the grated suet and diced juicy over the dough.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Cut into desired shapes and place on a baking sheet.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
